# Kusha Kumar NR — UX & Product Designer

> Portfolio of Kusha Kumar NR, a Senior UX & Product Designer (HFI CUA) with 8+ years of experience designing human-centered products across e-learning, ecommerce, healthcare, finance and airlines. Currently at Wipro.

Kusha bridges research, behavior and craft — turning ambiguous problems into intuitive, accessible products. The site covers experience, toolkit, education, selected case studies and contact.

## Pages

- [Home](/): About, experience, toolkit, selected work and contact.

## Projects

- [Airline Booking Kiosk](/projects/airline-booking-kiosk): End-to-end kiosk, mobile and web flows for check-in, booking and live flight tracking (Spekond Technology).
- [Enterprise SaaS Suite](/projects/enterprise-saas-suite): Multi-product enterprise platform aligning design across finance and SaaS verticals with a shared design system (Wipro).
- [Pearson Learning Experience](/projects/pearson-learning-experience): Research-led UX improvements with WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility for diverse learners.
- [Healthcare MVP](/projects/healthcare-mvp): Discovery research, service blueprint and clickable MVP prototype for a healthcare startup.
